abbreviations.expansion: abelian groups; abelian sheaves in Ab(Y)

notes: The page asks whether relative cohomology can be defined functorially in F, from the derived category of Ab(Y) to that of Ab. It says that a geometric interpretation using operations on n-champs de Picard, with n described as grand, suggests existence. It then says the writer sees an evident/evidente construction by hand only in two extreme cases. This page contains only item a). These are reports of the page’s claims, not mathematical conclusions of this reading.

Item a) calls the morphism (-1)-acyclique and states an injectivity condition involving F and g_*g^*F. The small relation after F remains dash/arrow ambiguous. The parenthetical NB names the slice morphism under the condition that p→e_Y is an épimorphisme, and refers to B with two low indices plus haut. The index identities and the middle of épimorphisme remain uncertain. No referenced earlier page was consulted.

The final line introduced by On prend gives a Coker expression inside derived sections, followed by the shift [-1]. The Gamma subscript is cancelled. The operator within the resolution group reads e; a brace points to the lower annotation résol. inj. The brace’s visible end lies under the first close after F. No mathematical validity of this construction was assessed.

Coverage: every text block, every word and ending, all accents and abbreviations, all inline and displayed formulas, all quotation boundaries, punctuation, indices, stars, arrows, parentheses, the shift, the two underlining marks, the cancellation and the lower annotation were compared against BOTH C and H, including all agreed text. The whole was viewed once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once in order. The supplied halves overlap; half_b has whole-source y offset 786. No whole image or half was reopened. Each of the 15 open loci was cropped once and viewed once; no OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer or LaTeX compilation was used.

The page is entirely handwritten in a dark-ink hand whose identity is not independently established by this packet. A separate pale pencil 12 occurs at bottom left and is transcribed as archive metadata. No author page number, title, date, total page count, letterhead, salutation, address, closing or signature occurs on this sheet. There are no independent diagrams, drawings or marginal pointers, and no separate insertion caret. The formula’s brace is mathematical annotation.

The large prefatory archive-order note in H is editorial and refers to pages outside the assigned scope. It was read as packet text but was not imported as source text or used to supply any reading. H’s note on résol. inj. credits that wording; the report’s difference is the operator identity and exact source brace/attachment, not a claim that H entirely omits the annotation’s words.

For ordinary Ab lettering, the difference between C mathit and H mathrm was treated as typesetting of the same plain handwritten A and b, not as a separately asserted special alphabet. Both occurrences were checked. The explicit extra internal upright of R, by contrast, was recorded as an alphabet difference.

The crowded initial g of géométrique was examined in c03. There are heavy/retraced and returning pen strokes, but no independently readable old letter or cancelled word; the live word is transcribed without inventing an underlying layer. Isolated points in the lower blank margin are detached surface/scan specks without a legible textual role and were not promoted to source punctuation.

All source boxes reported for half-settled differences were estimated from the once-viewed half, without reopening it. The main reader should make its own adjudication crop for the entries with empty crop_ids. Crop times are the clock readings immediately following their three-image viewing batches. start_utc is the first recorded clock timestamp; packet-text reading began immediately beforehand.

The missing stop after exister is based on c04: the thick final trace is connected to r, and no separate dot survives before the paper edge. The same no-visible-stroke principle applies after the closing NB parenthesis. No expected punctuation was supplied from sentence structure.

No proof, independent re-proof, formal computation or theorem check was performed. Counting the closing strokes and inspecting the positions of stars and braces were visual transcription checks only, so math_checks is empty.
